formal_role: Defines the domain shown in the phase line or phase plane
systems_modeling_role: Determines which system states are treated as relevant or meaningful
review_warning: A phase portrait can mislead if important regions are cropped or invalid regions are shown

formal_role: Assigns a derivative vector to each state-space point
systems_modeling_role: Shows the local direction and speed of system change
review_warning: Vector-field arrows depend on equations parameters scaling and grid resolution

formal_role: Identify where one component of motion is zero
systems_modeling_role: Reveal directional boundaries and equilibrium candidates
review_warning: Nullclines require domain checks and parameter documentation

formal_role: Chooses initial conditions for simulated paths
systems_modeling_role: Shows possible histories through state space
review_warning: Selected trajectories may overrepresent some outcomes and hide others

systems_modeling_role: Supports interpretation of recovery instability spirals cycles or thresholds
review_warning: Local stability labels should not be treated as global guarantees

formal_role: Defines how trajectories are approximated computationally
review_warning: Step size and solver choice can distort phase behavior
